name: ArDM
summary: ArDM is a tonne-scale liquid-argon TPC technology project, first tested at the surface at CERN and then deployed at Canfranc. Subsequent use of the equipment includes underground-argon background measurements.
detection_principle: The design combines liquid-argon scintillation and ionization for WIMP nuclear recoils. Published first underground data include single-phase commissioning runs; they do not establish full dual-phase physics operation.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
